en: Today I'm packing vegetables into jars.
If you pour honey over food in a jar,
and seal it airtight,
it will keep for quite a long time.
What I'm making now is going to be butter.
note: trailing space: msg 99251 prints #2084 and #2085 on one line with no separator

en: Like this, mixing in salt,
you work it with a spatula until it's firm.
I need to make some cheese next, too...
What a sweet scent. Heh heh, wonderful.
note: [PLAYER], stern voice; the scent's source is not named

en: I shall enjoy it as a delectable dessert.
note: object kept as 'it' (jam, or Celia herself?) - source gives no object

en: Come to think of it, like this,
it's like having preserved food in hand.
Aren't you adorable! Where are you from?
Um, I'm living at the villa to the east now.
you soon lose touch with what's around you.

Yet you keep coming to this plain old house.

so that's what it was.

en: Well, don't you look glum,
Pull yourself together.

, is it?

en: I'm Wendy the washerwoman,
If you've got any washing, tell me.
note: capitalised start because #2176 ends in a full stop; follows both #2116 and #2146

en: Stand up straight when you walk.
You look as glum as ever,
Are you all right?
I've never once worried about my husband,
but I do worry about you.
Hm? Well, don't you look glum,
Come on, cheer up and walk with some spirit.
Good day,
Nights get cold, don't they? Be careful.
Well, don't you look glum.
Oh, it's you. Still as listless as ever,
Can't you liven up a bit?
My strength isn't back yet. I have none to spare.
Don't make such strange excuses,
Eat a proper meal and get your energy up.
Is there something you want washed?
This house isn't a laundry counter,
so if that's it, come to the wash house.
Oh, it's just
You won't get anything by coming to my house, you know.
Did you really come to get laundry done?
Of course not. Ahahaha!
My husband may be unfriendly,
but it's not that he dislikes you.
Ios just isn't one to let things bother him.
Even your answer's got no life in it.
I'm Wendy,
a washerwoman, as you can see.
Oh, it's you,
What, do you want your curtains washed or something?
I seem to be fine for now,
I'll ask if I need anything.
Fair enough. But I mean it, you know.
note: 'honto da yo' read as Wendy insisting the offer is genuine

en: Aren't those clothes pretty dirty?
It looks like you've been wearing them for 100 years straight.
Things that are hard to wash by hand,
I beat with a stick, like this, over and over,
until they're clean.
It takes a fair bit of strength.
So that job falls to me.
All because I look the strongest, they say.
